head: 2d02c06ca
read: _design/reviews/max/** (env verify1/2, units verify1/2, vfx verify1 + vfx_measurements, sfx verify1/2 + 8 A/B jsons, idle_gates.json), _design/reviews/cards/verify_ks1/ks2/roll1/roll2.json, git log since 2026-11-11 12:00. There is no plan file under _design/reviews/max; the plan items are reconstructed from the verify files.

gaps.what: Sound effects lane failed its last verify (sfx/verify2: pass false, 7.0), and nothing has landed since (last sfx commit 69519e8f2 at 23:46, verdict at 00:17).
gaps.why: On the current build probe_audio_runtime fails: master integrated loudness is -19.95 / -20.18 / -19.6 LUFS on 3 of 5 captures (owner token -18 +/- 1.5) and fighter kit share is 47.5 % / 46.4 % on jungle-heavy seed 21 (bar >= 50 %). The idle gate ran only audio_sync, not the runtime mix, so 'all hard gates pass' does not cover it.
gaps.howToFix: SFX fix round 2: raise the sfx bus or the kit-hit gains by about +1 dB, trim the library cues that top seed 21 (c_cast_big, c_monster_fall, c_hit_magic, c_needle_shot, c_slam), then run probe_audio_runtime match on at least seeds 3, 7, 11 and 21 and require all to pass.

gaps.what: Hit sounds are not snappier, and many abilities still share one hit sound (SFX-2 onset, SFX-4).
gaps.why: Median onset-to-peak is 6.4 ms against the plan's 3 ms. Nine kit hits stay under the HF floors (both Dunsom slots, tunlan_hit, ulkro_attack_hit, hesmi_attack_hit, lisvel_attack_hit, nurrow_hit). SFX-4 (per-ability Q/W/E impacts) was never attempted, so 'sound effects for all things' is not met for abilities.
gaps.howToFix: Shape a 1-3 ms transient layer per material in audio/build.py and gate onset <= 3 ms. Add per-ability impact cues (at least the ultimates and the heaviest Q/W/E per fighter) as kit-hit variants. Restore the IMPW window to 0.15 s and re-take f_odrum_hit instead of relaxing it.

gaps.what: SFX-10 (UI and shop sounds in the max plan) was not done; it was handed to the UI lane, and that lane has no record of picking it up.
gaps.why: sfx/verify1 and verify2 both mark it 'same, not done'. The owner asked for better sound on all things.
gaps.howToFix: Give SFX-10 an owner lane and a verify, or record it as out of scope in owner_rulings with the reason.

gaps.what: Visual effects lane: every verify1 problem is still open. content/vfx.json is unchanged since 011d4e042 (17:08), and there was no fix round or verify2.
gaps.why: Still in the def: lib_structure_break has a team light radius 9, intensity 8 (whole-frame blue flood); the lib_death_shatter scorch is #2A2C33 (a black-hole centre); ink_puff near-black blobs in structure_break/land (env verify2); a dark-ball silence status; Sunsplinter and Longshade sweeps on the opaque cone mesh. Not built: VFX-5c item procs, monster death and enrage. VFX-6 ult re-tune is Marund only, and Lisvel, Nurrow and Vashil sit at detailLost 2, the limit. In my death spot-check the dark ink puff over the body and the dark disc under it are both visible.
gaps.howToFix: VFX fix round: light radius 5-6 or intensity 5 on structure_break; scorch centre to a dark warm grey; ink_puff toward the dust value; open bell rim for silence; additive rim-weighted sweeps; build the item-proc and monster death/enrage defs; re-tune the four ults. Then an adversarial verify2.

gaps.what: Units lane is below par (6.8 -> 7.0). Its headline deficit, material zoning, is open.
gaps.why: U1 is a global chroma lift, not per-fighter zoning. Kemdo, Burdam, Vashil and Tunlan still read cream or beige at the game camera, and Rishal's crimson does not reach the body. Still deferred: ORM roughness zoning, U6 emissives, U7 heads, the Glasshorn restyle and the Sunsplinter core. Hesmi was never captured in game (an empty crop on every seed tried).
gaps.howToFix: Do U1(1)/(2): partmap_mask albedo zones (signature hue >= 6 % of body pixels, lower body at L* 20-35) and ORM G bands per part class, gated with lineup_qa. Fix the harness so Hesmi is in frame. Rebuild or widen the stillness watch for Ervet and Odrum recall (70 / 60 frames).

gaps.what: Environment lane closed at 7.4, under the 7.5 par (ruling 23's 7.4 allowance is for the monsters row only).
gaps.why: The RIFT canopy is one Dialwood fan species. The outflow keeps a lit left edge and reads faint. Never started: base plaza dressing, tower soot, god rays and BRIDGE deck bays (env verify1).
gaps.howToFix: A second and a third crown silhouette that replace some Dialwood instances (triangle-neutral: the match peak is 462k of 500k), floor value break-up in the clearings, a feathered outflow side edge; then the unstarted items, or a recorded deferral.

gaps.what: Card issues are not fixed: every fighter's cards fail adversarial verification, and none reaches 7.5.
gaps.why: roll1 24/42 fail, roll2 26/42 fail, ks2 Kemdo 6.0 / Sukri 5.0 fail. Burdam (3.0) and Dunsom (3.5) fail all 12 cards on model-driven hollow-mask or cracked-skull reads. There are hollow-eye and blank-mannequin reads on Tunlan cards, and under-eye streaks on Sukri. card_qa and the paint_card eye gates pass all of these, so the automatic gates miss them. Vashil's cowl-crown blocker (CW5) is still open. No card commit has landed since the 23:41 roll1 verdict; only uncommitted renders (ardit, dunsom _fit/_fp2) sit in the tree.
gaps.howToFix: Fix Burdam's and Dunsom's faces at the model (sensitivity class), then re-render. Add a by-eye blocker list (hollow mask, cracked skull, blank face, under-eye streak) to card_qa. Do a paint pass that adds form, light and rim and larger figure framing. Re-verify all 16 fighters.

gaps.what: Frame timing for the integrated build is not proven.
gaps.why: realtime_match came back not_measured twice (load 3.31 and 4.6 from Spotlight). The second run 'would pass', but ruling 20/27/28 needs a valid idle run. The margins are tight: 462k of 500k tris, RIFT match memory 2865 of 3000 MB, RIFT Low structure L* p95 79.5 of 80.
gaps.howToFix: One idle realtime_match re-run (load < 3 throughout; pause Spotlight indexing for the run if the owner allows it). Any later visuals work must re-check the three tight margins.

gaps.what: Shopping in base is limited to an 18 m circle round the fountain, not the whole base.
gaps.why: Spot-check: at 21.5 m (inside the bell Needles' line, still in the team's base) and at 35 m (before the Lanterns at ~28-30 m), canShop is false. The owner asked to buy 'in base'. The home platform and dead cases work.
gaps.howToFix: Lead ruling by delegation (record in owner_rulings.md): either keep 18 m as the platform (the industry norm is fountain-only, so 18 m is already generous) and record it, or make BASE_ZONE_R reach the Lantern line (~26 m) with a probe_sim_shop case.

weakABs: vfx VFX-5 'better' is marked partial in its own evidence (the sweeps are recoloured old meshes; item procs and monster defs were not built).
vfx VFX-6 'better' rests on one fighter (Marund) out of five planned.
vfx VFX-3 'better' while respawn is still one light column and summon leaves a black ink stain.
vfx VFX-4 'better' while the verifier notes a black-hole scorch and a whole-frame blue flood (both still in vfx.json).
vfx verify1 is the only verify of that lane. Its 'pass 7.5' was never re-checked after other lanes changed post and grades (env ENV-8/9, the ink.ts ward fix).
units U8 'better' (Sunsplinter x1.42) was not re-measured by verify2; it is extrapolated from verify1's x1.4 number. U4 is 'better' by carry-over with no new A/B.
env ENV-7 'better' cites only the engineer's sheet, with no recapture. ENV-6 is self-described as 'modest' (three chunks still flat cool grey).
sfx SFX-2 'better' rests on HF energy; the plan's onset target (<= 3 ms) was missed (6.4 ms).

spotChecks.claim: 75ab44c52: buy anywhere on your home platform or while dead (RIFT shopAccess base_or_dead, BASE_ZONE_R 18 m)
spotChecks.evidence: Live practice RIFT match on the dev server (scratchpad spot.mjs, Ardit, team 0). Spawn: canShop true. Teleported 14.6 m from the fountain and 16 m from the counter: canShop true. P opens the Lampwright with no access line, and a buy landed (sap_flask). After dying under the enemy outer Needle (state dead): the shop opens with BUY enabled on a greyed world, and a buy landed (spare_lamp). At 18.4 m, 21.5 m and 35 m from the fountain: canShop false. Shot: _harness/_shots/spot_shop_dead.png. 0 console lines.

spotChecks.claim: VFX-3: level-up is a dial-ring stair with a shaft and tick dial (vfx verify1 'better')
spotChecks.evidence: Practice 'Level up' with a frame at 150 ms (_harness/_shots/spot_levelup_150.png): concentric bright dial rings with ticks in white and violet at the feet, rising around the fighter, clearly readable at the game camera. No white tube fills the frame.

spotChecks.claim: VFX-4 death shatter is better, and SFX-5 gives structures their own voices (the Needle shot is audible as its own cue)
spotChecks.evidence: Death under the enemy Needle: cueLog shows c_needle_shot, c_needle_hit, c_shield_break, f_ardit_death, m_self_down, so the structure and death voices fire. The death frame 0.5 s after (_harness/_shots/spot_dead.png) shows the violet ring and chips, but also the near-black ink puff over the body and a dark disc under it, the defects verify1 and env verify2 flagged. content/vfx.json still has lib_death_shatter scorch #2A2C33 and lib_structure_break light radius 9, intensity 8. Those verdicts hold only with these defects still open.

verdictNote: The hard counts and memory gates in idle_gates.json hold (perf_1080 prod: High/Ultra 39 programs, match peak 462k tris and 278 draws; memory RIFT 2865 MB). The pass is not complete, though: SFX failed its last verify with no fix, VFX had one verify round and fixed none of its problems, units (7.0) and env (7.4) sit under par, all 16 fighters' cards fail, and the real-time frame gate is unmeasured. The owner's ask, graphics, every effect, sound for all things and the cards, is not done. The shop ask is done for the dead and home-platform cases.
